verdict.rationale: Metorial documents two ways to plug in MCP servers. You can link a remote MCP endpoint and use it like any other provider, or upload your own MCP server code for Metorial to host. Tools from attached providers are merged and exposed to the AI in a session, with tool filters to control which ones are available. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an external MCP server and invoking its tools end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Use a remote MCP server when the provider already offers an MCP endpoint. Metorial connects to it and you can use it like any other provider on Metorial.
you can upload your own MCP server code and let Metorial host it.
The tools from all of them are merged and exposed to your AI.
1200+ integrations across SaaS tools, enterprise systems, data sources, and custom MCP servers.
